business_summary: Shoei Foods Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, procures, processes, manufactures, sells, and imports food products in Japan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers fruits, including prunes, raisins, cranberries, blueberries, strawberries, mandarin oranges, lemons, mangoes, grapefruits, figs, dates, cherries, apples, apricots, grapes, raspberries, goji berries, pineapples, papayas, goldenberries, gingers, bananas, cherry tomatoes, aloes, mixed fruits, peaches, and pears; and nuts such as almonds, almond milk, walnuts and processed walnut products, macadamia nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, pecan nuts, pistachio nuts, coconuts, pine nuts, and sunflower and pumpkin seeds. It also provides confectionery and bread making ingredients comprising candied chestnuts, chestnut pastes, processed chestnut products, candied plums, sweet potato and chocolate processed products, maple syrups, baked confectioneries, powdered sugar, almond frost, custard powder, nata de coco and tapioca, fruit jam and filling, and fruit pickles and puree; and dairy products, which include butter, imported mozzarella and cream cheese, imported dairy products and preparations, condensed and fermented milks, cafe and confectionery ingredients, dairy lactic acid bacteria beverages, powder products, reconstituted concentrated milk, formulated milk powder, soft mix, and caramel products. In addition, the company offers foodservice ingredients, such as pasta, olive oil, tomatoes, table olives, cones, tuna processed products, processed potato products, mushrooms, steamed beans, fruit magic dolce and sauce, dessert syrups and jellies, and topping ingredients; and home products comprising prune small bags, nuts and seeds sachets, dried fruit packets, and other retail items. Further, it operates and manages walnut, prune, and almond farms. The company was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Shoei Foods Corporation은 자회사와 함께 일본, 중국, 미국 및 국제적으로 식품을 조달, 가공, 제조, 판매 및 수입합니다. 이 회사는 자두, 건포도, 크랜베리, 블루베리, 딸기, 만다린 오렌지, 레몬, 망고, 자몽, 무화과, 대추, 체리, 사과, 살구, 포도, 라즈베리, 구기자, 파인애플, 파파야, 골든베리, 생강, 바나나, 방울토마토, 알로에, 혼합 과일, 복숭아, 배를 포함한 과일을 제공합니다. 및 아몬드, 아몬드밀크, 호두 및 호두가공품, 마카다미아넛, 캐슈넛, 헤이즐넛, 피칸넛, 피스타치오넛, 코코넛, 잣, 해바라기 및 호박씨 등의 견과류를 포함한다. 또한 설탕에 절인 밤, 밤 페이스트, 밤 가공 제품, 설탕에 절인 자두, 고구마 및 초콜릿 가공 제품, 메이플 시럽, 구운 과자, 가루 설탕, 아몬드 프로스트, 커스터드 분말, 나타 데 코코 및 타피오카, 과일 잼 및 충전재, 과일 피클 및 퓌레로 구성된 제과 및 빵 제조 재료를 제공합니다. 버터, 수입 모짜렐라 및 크림 치즈, 수입 유제품 및 조제품을 포함한 유제품
